name: byoc R-6: live lifecycle/recovery journeys J1-J4, 1h soak, teardown census and budget on real GCP, release 0.0.21-p318r62b (release task 0munwgut01uzlcjdajh)
summary: su-9b75fa7c ran the J2/J3 chain on GCP project active-alcove-504205-q3 with bg-host on release 0.0.21-p318r62b (bundle dea508a8, the R-4 artifact). Host A (host-pc-p318-j23a-20261001-r62b2) was provisioned, canaried and probed: a repository clone with HEAD 8d83cc8f, owner papercusp-workspace, mode 770 and a named-user ACL. A was snapshotted (p318-j23-r62b2-snapshot-a-1) and destroyed, so the original VM was unavailable. The snapshot was restored onto a new host B (host-pc-p318-j23b-20261001-r62b2, op p318-j23-r62b2-restore-b-1); B was bootstrapped and its canary passed all five credential stages. The probe on B found the same clone with identical HEAD, owner, mode, birth time and full ACL (J3_DATA_ACL_PRESERVED). B was destroyed with a committed evidence census (p318-j23-r62b2-destroy-b-1), the snapshot was deleted, and the final gcloud census for both run labels returned zero instances, disks, networks, firewall rules and routers. The chain ended CHAIN_OK at 00:28:44Z. J1, J4, the soak and the r62 canary teardown were already recorded on the same release (D-445) and are cited by receipt below.

J1.name: upgrade and rollback on a real host
J1.note: r63 to r62b upgrade, then rollback by a second upgrade r62b to r63 (D-390). Both succeeded on 2026-10-01.

J2.name: restore from snapshot with the original VM unavailable
J2.note: Host A was deleted before the restore. gcloud confirmed no p318-j23a instance, network or firewall remained. The restore created host B from the snapshot, and B initialized and served its canary (HTTP 200, ready-for-destroy at 2026-10-02T00:24:24Z).

J3.name: data and ACL preservation across VM replacement
J3.acl: user::rwx user:papercusp-agent:rwx user:papercusp:rwx user:papercusp-workspace:rwx group::rwx mask::rwx other::--- plus matching default: entries; identical on A and B
J3.note: Credential re-binding on the replacement VM is covered by canary:p318-j23b-20261001-r62b2:restore-rebind, which succeeded.

J4.name: credential rotation, revocation and reconnect
J4.note: Passed on three independent r62b hosts.

J5.name: agent execution during a Papercusp-service outage
J5.note: Not built in any release. Removed from R-6's required set and moved to plan aws-byoc-gcp-parity-2026-10-01 by D-445.

j23HostB.message: Workspace-host discard teardown and evidence census completed

j23HostA.message: Workspace-host resources were deleted, but terminal evidence is incomplete
j23HostA.providerAbsence: gcloud: no instance, disk, network, firewall rule or router for papercusp_run_id=p318-j23a-20261001-r62b2

finalCensus.snapshotNote: The two matches are p318-j23-r38-source-snapshot and p318-j23-r44-source-snapshot from 2026-09-22 and 2026-09-24 runs; neither belongs to this run.

budget.note: Queried 2026-10-02T00:33Z. The export had not yet ingested the 2026-10-01 J2/J3 runs. Their spend is bounded by the admitted 2500-cent cap per run; both hosts lived under two hours on e2-class machines.

assertions.evidence: Required journeys J1-J4 passed on real GCP hosts running the R-4 artifact (0.0.21-p318r62b, bundle dea508a8). J2 restored onto a new VM after the original was deleted; J3 showed identical data and ACLs on the replacement. The 1h soak passed 61/61. Teardown left zero provider resources for every run label. Budget is admitted per run against GCP budget a5775eed and measured from the billing export. J5 is out of the required set per D-445.

limitations: Host A's destroy operation deleted every provider resource but ended failed with 'terminal evidence incomplete' (EI-24818981551847665). Zero residue for A rests on the gcloud census, not on a committed census receipt.
The billing export had not yet ingested the 2026-10-01 J2/J3 runs when this file was written; those runs are bounded by their admitted spend caps.
J1 ran on the customer host avi-test, not on a fresh canary host.
